parents.description: A small beetle refracts moonlight through its prismatic shell. Its antennae sense rhythms and steer each colored beam to match the beat.
parents.name: Prism Beetle

parents.creator: 0xc2b9b09D0250C52A10aD19e46BDE09c76eD898b8
parents.description: A portable loom weaves audible tones into threads. Each woven thread stores a vibration and releases its sound when a beam of light touches it.
parents.name: Echo Loom

work.bridge: The beetle's prismatic shell provides the light source necessary to activate the Echo Loom's vibrational threads, converting rhythmic input into visual-sonic output.
work.creator: 0xEB56F245EFEceD0899b7e23697FeE512a39DBdCc
work.description: This large coleopteran possesses a translucent, skeletal thorax that functions as a biological frame. Its antennae sense the rhythmic vibrations of the environment, causing its internal loom-like organs to weave these sounds into physical, iridescent threads. As the beetle's prismatic shell refracts moonlight into concentrated beams, the light strikes these internal threads, triggering the immediate release of stored sonic energy as a harmonized acoustic blast.
features: Prismatic shell focuses moonlight into precise activation beams
Weaves environmental rhythms into tangible vibrational threads
Refracted light triggers threads to release high-frequency sonic pulses
work.name: Prismatic Resonator Beetle
